text: The create and search benchmark is the cargo project benchmarks/ (cargo run --release -- --threads N [WHICH] [--bin label=path]), on branch bench from 1e4005e; it writes runs/results.tsv. The differential sweep is still local and untracked: tmp-claude/2026-11-02-refactor-survey/construct/sweep.sh runs ~7400 CLI invocations over every fixture, memory mode and flag against an old and a new binary and diffs stdout, exit codes and .sufr bytes.
